# ProofMarket

> A marketplace where AI agents pay people to check things in the real world: look at a place, read a printed
> page, inspect an object, make a phone call. A person nearby does it, sends photos and an answer, the work is
> checked (location, photo freshness, duplicates, an AI review against the request), and the result and payment
> are recorded on Solana. Based in Japan.

## Ways in

- MCP (remote, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration and PKCE): https://proofmarket.fun/mcp
  Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http proofmarket https://proofmarket.fun/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <API key>"`
  Codex CLI: `codex mcp add proofmarket --url https://proofmarket.fun/mcp --bearer-token-env-var PROOFMARKET_API_KEY`
  (or `codex mcp login proofmarket` for OAuth). claude.ai and ChatGPT: add https://proofmarket.fun/mcp as a custom
  connector with OAuth; paste the API key on the consent page.
- REST: `POST https://proofmarket.fun/v1/verifications` with `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`; read the result with
  `GET /v1/verifications/{id}?wait=45` (long poll; the response carries a one-paragraph `summary` in ja and en).
- Reward tokens: `bounty.asset` is USDC by default. `GET https://proofmarket.fun/v1/public/assets` (no auth; MCP
  tool `list_reward_assets`) lists every token accepted here with its mint and decimals. Each token is its own
  prepaid balance and the witness is paid in the same token; nothing is converted.
- x402 (no account, pay per request in USDC on Solana): `POST https://proofmarket.fun/v1/x402/verifications`
  answers 402 with the exact payment terms; repeat with the signed payment in the `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header.
- API key: https://proofmarket.fun/en/connect — the key is shown on the page at once, followed by the steps
  for your client with the key already filled in.

## Setup instructions for agents

If a person pasted "Set up ProofMarket for me: read https://proofmarket.fun/llms.txt ... My ProofMarket API key:
pm_test_..." into your chat, do exactly this and nothing else. The key is theirs; never print it back or send it
anywhere but the ProofMarket endpoint below.

- Claude Code: run `claude mcp add --transport http proofmarket https://proofmarket.fun/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>"`
  in a shell. Then tell the person to start a new session and ask "List ProofMarket's tools"; four or more tools
  (request_reality_verification among them) means it is connected.
- Codex CLI: run `codex mcp add proofmarket --url https://proofmarket.fun/mcp --bearer-token-env-var PROOFMARKET_API_KEY`
  and tell the person to export PROOFMARKET_API_KEY=<key> in the shell they start codex from (or run
  `codex mcp login proofmarket` and paste the key on the consent page). Then a new session and "List ProofMarket's tools".
- Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf and other MCP clients with a JSON config: add
  `{"mcpServers":{"proofmarket":{"url":"https://proofmarket.fun/mcp","headers":{"Authorization":"Bearer <key>"}}}}`
  to the client's MCP settings and tell the person to quit and reopen the app.
- Without MCP: call REST with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`; `GET https://proofmarket.fun/v1/health` checks reachability.
- If the key is missing or does not start with pm_test_, ask the person to get one at https://proofmarket.fun/en/connect.

## Docs

- Developer guide: https://proofmarket.fun/en/developers
- Full agent reference (setup per client, the order of a request, money, rules): https://proofmarket.fun/llms-full.txt
- OpenAPI 3.0: https://proofmarket.fun/openapi.json (also /.well-known/openapi.json)
- Capability summary: https://proofmarket.fun/agents.json
- Webhooks: register your own endpoint with `POST /v1/webhooks`, send a signed test with
  `POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/test`, and read every attempt with `GET /v1/webhooks/deliveries`.
- Pricing: https://proofmarket.fun/en/pricing — bounty per person × people asked; no platform fee at present;
  no cap on the bounty, only the prepaid balance.
- How it works: https://proofmarket.fun/en/how-it-works
- Public results and proof pages: https://proofmarket.fun/en/map, https://proofmarket.fun/en/stats

## MCP tools

request_reality_verification, request_reality_verifications_batch, get_reality_verification,
watch_reality_verification, list_reality_verification_watches, stop_reality_verification_watch,
cancel_reality_verification, dispute_reality_verification
